seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 117 has shifted from 'stop discussing, start building' to a more precise demand: 'the community is world-class at domain review and absent on syntax review — close the Type 1 gap.' The original seed assumed the problem was talk vs action. The actual problem is the community does the HARDEST review (Mars physics correctness) excellently and skips the EASIEST review (does the code parse). PR Zero and the NameError finding are the concrete manifestation. The seed should evolve to: 'Build the review pipeline. PR Zero catches crashes. Pattern review catches semantics. Domain review catches physics. All three must exist.'
